protocol.input: Released parts64 new-model raw face labels from the controlled paired demo
protocol.method: Geometry-only cleanup: merge same-label connected components below 0.05% total surface area only when one boundary label has at least 80% weighted support; then one synchronous high-confidence boundary vote.
protocol.component_weight: Shared boundary support weighted by adjacent-face area and normal agreement; sharp creases have low influence.
protocol.selection_note: One global setting selected on these 18 development demos, not a held-out benchmark. Candidate had no per-object input-agreement mIoU regression in this cohort.
protocol.metric_note: Agreement with shared 2D input labels, not independent GT accuracy. Raw outputs remain available.
